props.title: The Mentors Behind Aether
props.description: This project exists because mentors gave precision, challenge, and care at every critical turning point.

props.title: Mentorship as core infrastructure
props.body:
Aether was shaped in rooms where mentors asked harder questions than we expected and offered steadier support than we deserved. They challenged assumptions, redirected weak decisions, and helped us build a system that protects students while remaining practical to implement.

This page is a standing acknowledgment that mentorship is core infrastructure, as important to project quality as code, design, and research.

items.title: Mr. Shalif Shaoul
items.description: With gratitude for your guidance and encouragement throughout the Aether journey. Your mentorship strengthened both our technical direction and our confidence to keep building with purpose.

items.title: Subasri Dorairaj & Ramanjanappa Ravikumar
items.description: With deep gratitude for your unwavering support, guidance, sacrifices, and belief throughout the Aether journey. Your love, values, and steady encouragement made this work possible and gave it meaning beyond the project itself.

items.label: Mentor-informed product pivots
items.description: Key architecture and UX decisions improved after mentor reviews.

items.label: Feedback sessions incorporated
items.description: Guidance translated into concrete accessibility, safety, and governance updates.

items.label: Research and ethics checkpoints
items.description: Mentor input strengthened evidence alignment and responsible AI boundaries.

items.title: Clarity Under Pressure
items.description: Mentors helped narrow broad ideas into practical, student-safe product pathways that teams can actually ship.

items.title: Ethics Before Velocity
items.description: Mentorship kept privacy, fairness, and duty-of-care considerations as non-negotiable guardrails.

items.title: Research to Practice
items.description: Mentors continuously translated theory into implementation details that survive real-world constraints.

items.title: Human-Centered Standards
items.description: Critical reviews improved readability, accessibility, and the emotional tone of high-stress student journeys.

props.title: Mentor Constellation
props.body: Mentorship influence appears in clusters. Guidance, encouragement, rigor, and integrity connect across every release.

items.title: Guidance
items.description: Consistent direction during key architectural and product choices.

items.title: Encouragement
items.description: Support that sustained momentum through complex and ambiguous milestones.

items.title: Rigor
items.description: Feedback that improved quality, clarity, and implementation discipline.

items.title: Integrity
items.description: Values-based coaching that reinforced privacy, safety, and fairness choices.

items.title: Attribution by Design
items.description: Major decisions are accompanied by mentorship context in internal changelogs, not just release notes.

items.title: Mentor Credit Ledger
items.description: Each milestone records who shaped the decision, what changed, and how the impact was measured.

items.title: Teach-Forward Practice
items.description: Every mentorship insight is converted into templates and guidance so future teams benefit too.

items.title: Annual Gratitude Review
items.description: A yearly review revisits mentor impact and updates recognition artifacts across docs and website.

items.question: Why dedicate a full page to mentors?
items.answer: Because meaningful mentorship is not a footnote. It shaped the product strategy, safety model, and implementation quality of Aether.

items.question: How should mentor names be displayed?
items.answer: Use explicit consent, preferred titles, and context about what each person contributed. Recognition should be accurate and respectful.

items.question: Can this page support institutions and cohorts?
items.answer: Yes. The structure is designed to recognize individuals, faculty groups, and program cohorts with equal clarity.
